verdict.rationale: Datacenter-scale training and serving is a fair axis for a GPU, so the story applies. However, the evidence pack documents no NVLink or other high-bandwidth interconnect, no multi-GPU system support, and no rack-scale deployment for the RTX 5080. The materials position it as a gaming and local AI PC part (DLSS, Reflex, local model inference on RTX AI PCs), and the CUDA toolkit items are general software tooling, not evidence of datacenter-scale hardware.
